evidence: Bug reproduced at base: through the real AgentConversationPage with a replayed streaming:true assistant frame and text typed, Send disabled === true and a click posts 0 times.

Lost draft at base: with api.createAgentMessage rejecting, the error line shows and the textarea value is empty (assistant-ui clears the draft at send, core base-composer-runtime-core.ts:342-348; AgentConversationPage.tsx:125-131 swallows the error).

designDecisions: D1: AgentRuntimeThread passes isRunning: false explicitly (not omitted: thread-runtime.ts:220-227 falls back to the trailing message status). Streaming rendering keeps each message's own status. Queue capability rejected (fake queue with no-op move/edit/remove). isRunning() in conversation.ts is deleted; stale comments at conversation.ts:160-163 and agent-view.e2e.ts:384-387, 410-416 rewritten. Side effect intended: no empty upcoming-assistant placeholder turn.

D2: ComposerPrimitive.Send replaced by RefusableButton type=submit inside ComposerPrimitive.Root; refusal 'Type a message first.' while composer.isEmpty; busy 'Sending…' while this session's send is out; a visible line inside the form (refusalShownBy) showing the reason or 'Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line'; data-testid agent-composer still encloses the whole composer.
D3: one send out per session (held-sends.ts:152-157): isSendDisabled while the current session's send is out; per session, so A's send never holds B.

D4: restore only when api.createAgentMessage rejects (a 201 with a failed delivery is success); refresh moves out of the try. Refused text goes before text typed since, blank line between. Written into the box only while the reader is on the sending session; a refusal landing elsewhere is kept for its own session and shown when the reader returns. Error line per session; ownSendCount bumped only for the session on screen. Restore via runtime thread.composer.setText, not MessageNotSentError.
D5: per-session drafts across an in-app session switch, kept in the page (leaving the live view drops them).

D6: held-sends matched in behaviour (its store cannot be reused: sendRequest strips /aside and /btw prefixes, changing what the live view sends). Not matched: the box stays usable during a send; a refusal after leaving the live view is lost. Same as held-sends: a refusal after the server stored the message is handed back, so resending can duplicate it.

findings.finding: Draft restore needs session ownership; one runtime survives a session switch, so a late refusal could land in another session's box.

findings.finding: Overlapping sends: order and exactly-once of restored bodies undefined; library restore covers only the newest generation.
findings.answer: D3: one send out per session (held-sends rule) via isSendDisabled, so sends never overlap; Dispatch restores itself via setText. U5.
